# Draft:Battle Of Khwakurk

The Battle of Khwakurk was a military engagement between the Kurdish Peshmerga forces led by Massoud Barzani, and Iraqi forces, led by Saddam Hussein. The engagement took place in 1988, resulting in a decisive Kurdish victory. The Iraqi soldiers numbered between 30,000-40,000, while the Kurds only numbered between 2,000-3,000 soldiers. The Iraqi forces used Chemical weapons in an attempt to capture Khwakurk, as it was in an extremely strategic location.
